'''''CRC Standard Mathematical Tables''''' (also '''''CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulas''''' or '''''SMTF''''') is a comprehensive one-volume handbook containing a fundamental working knowledge of mathematics and tables of formulas.<ref>{{cite web |last=Zwillinger |first=Daniel |title=Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulae |website=www.mathtable.com |url=http://www.mathtable.com/smtf/ |access-date=2024-08-09}}</ref>

==History==
The handbook was originally published in 1928 by the Chemical Rubber Company (now [[CRC Press]]) as a supplement (''Mathematical Tables'') to the ''[[CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics]]''.

Beginning with the 10th edition (1956), it was published as ''CRC Standard Mathematical Tables'' and kept this title up to the 29th edition (1991). The 30th edition (1996) was renamed ''CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulae'', with Daniel Ian Zwillinger as the editor-in-chief.<ref name="CRC 30">{{cite book |last=Zwillinger |first=Daniel |title=CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulae |edition=30 |publisher=CRC Press |publication-place=Boca Raton |date=1996 |isbn=0-8493-2479-3}}</ref> The 33rd edition (2018) was renamed ''CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulas''.<ref name="CRC 33">{{cite book |last=Zwillinger |first=Daniel |title=CRC Standard Mathematical Tables and Formulas |edition=33 |publisher=CRC Press |publication-place=Boca Raton |date=2018 |isbn=978-1-4987-7780-3}}</ref>
